1.Des: This land is abundant in resources, and is easily harvested. Supplies are plentiful.

2.Des: This land is lacking in resources, and is hard to harvest. Supplies are starting to run low.

3.Des: This land is barren and very difficult to harvest. Supplies are lacking.

4.Des: It's impossible to harvest any resources from this land. All supplies have run out, and no stat bonuses can be granted here.

1001.Des: Influenced by the forbidden power of the mysterious temple, its intangible power has a way of forcing people to push past their limits when faced with danger. For the first #.SArg0#s of battle, all heroes have their damage increased by #.SArg1.Per#. When the first target is killed, the hero who deals the highest damage on the team which dealt the kill will receive #.SArg2.Per# Attack Rating, #.SArg3# Haste, #.SArg4# Magic Pierce, and #.SArg5# Physical Pierce buffs until the end of the battle.
1001.PreviewDes: This primordial forest contains within it a temple that once belonged to an ancient civilization. It's said that the vestiges of forbidden tower within will favor the one who is first to gain the upper hand in battle.

1002.Des: This place has been affected by the Elemental Strife, the elements are imbalanced, and the essence of fire permeates the air. The direct damage of all heroes is reduced by #.SArg1.Per#, but when they deal damage multiple times to the same enemy within a short duration, they will acquire #.SArg5# Energy points per time with their damage to the enemy gradually increasing, up to a maximum of #.SArg4.Per#. When damage has stopped being dealt to the enemy, the increased damage effect will slowly diminish over time.
1002.PreviewDes: The Smoldering Peaks are being eroded by raging fire. Successive attacks will be continuously affected by the raging fire that engulfs the area.

1003.Des: The freezing force of Crystal Reservoir will disrupt the energy recovery of all characters. At the beginning of the battle, all heroes take #.SArg0.Per# less damage, and the damage reduction effect decreases over time for #.SArg1#s and eventually dissipates. During the battle, heroes cannot gain shields, all energy recovery effects are reduced by #.SArg2.Per#, and energy reduction effects are increased by #.SArg3.Per#.
1003.PreviewDes: The freezing force of Crystal Reservoir will disrupt the energy recovery of all characters.

1004.Des: The fog here is a barrier, the muddy swamp a deep abyss. Shape-shifting Hypogeans lurk here, making it hard for adventurers to tell friend from foe. All units are factionless, meaning all factional skills, advantages, and formations will be ineffective during battles.
1004.PreviewDes: The fog here acts as a barrier, and the mud resembles a deep abyss. The Hypogeans that can transmogrify at will lurk within, making it hard for adventurers to tell between friend and foe.
